subject: lion's mane jellyfish
title: A Jellyfish Washed Ashore Longer Than a Blue Whale

scenes.text: A jellyfish once washed up longer than a blue whale.
Its bell measured about seven feet wide. That isn't the long part.
The tentacles trailed for around 120 feet, recorded in Massachusetts Bay.
It was a lion's mane jellyfish, and that record is still the longest for any jellyfish.
Most today are far smaller, but their sting is no joke. Vinegar is the fix.
So the longest animal might not be a whale at all.

description:
A lion's mane jellyfish was recorded with tentacles about 120 feet long, longer than a blue whale.
The bell was only about seven feet wide. The record is still disputed, but it is the longest jellyfish on record.
Could you spot one in the water?
